node.title: Null-line trees yield exact all-subset incidence resources
node.statement: Over an odd-characteristic field, trees on distinct affine lines with nondegenerate ternary-null directions form a triangle-free graph with at most two common neighbours per triple. The independent-triple convex inequality gives sufficient edge caps K_s. Reconnecting every actual s-subset and averaging gives sum f_(M,s)(r_i)<=K_s, hence exact nonnegative dual bounds on fibre-weighted incidence. No extremal conjecture or random-survival premise is used.
